timeline.summary: Gem Aromatics reported Q4FY26 results with sequential improvement in revenue and EBITDA, commenced commercial production at Dahej facility, and provided FY28 guidance while withholding FY27 guidance due to geopolitical uncertainty.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹104 Cr (+16.2% YoY), net loss ₹7.01 Cr (against a loss of ₹2.58 Cr a year earlier).
Gem Aromatics released its Q2 & H1FY27 investor presentation highlighting revenue growth and progress on new product commercialisation at Dahej.
